name: Duc Dang
headline: I build runtimes for the web.
subline: A React-compatible UI library, and Node.js that runs inside a browser tab.

cards.desc: A React-compatible UI library from scratch. Fiber reconciler, hooks, Suspense and a router, in about 10 KB.
One command scaffolds a Rectify app, with the Vite plugin already wired in.
Node.js in your browser tab. Web Workers, npm install and dev servers like Vite, Next.js and Express, with no backend.
The earlier take: a virtual filesystem, shell, node and npm, and live preview, all inside workers.
